judgments.reason: The span 'a ~9 mm round, hyperechoic mass adherent to the ventricular surface of the anterior tricuspid leaflet' appears literally in the vignette (TTE findings) and directly supports localization of the papillary fibroelastoma to the tricuspid valve.

The span 'a 6×8 mm non-solid structure on the ventricular aspect of the anterior tricuspid leaflet' appears literally in the vignette (TEE findings) and further supports the anatomical modifier specifying the tricuspid valve location of the papillary fibroelastoma.
